claims.text: The hotel is directly opposite the Schlossgarten park, a few minutes' walk from Stuttgart Central Station.

findings.quote: Only a few minutes' walk from Stuttgart Central Station and directly opposite the "Schlossgarten"

claims.text: Across the park lies the Königstrasse, Stuttgart's central street for shopping and entertainment.

findings.quote: Across the park, Stuttgart's central street, the Königstrasse, invites guests for shopping and entertainment.

claims.text: Guests can walk to the Königstraße, the Staatsgalerie, the state opera and both the New and Old Castles.

findings.quote: you can easily walk to major attractions, including the popular Königstraße shopping strip, the Staatsgalerie, the state opera and both the New and Old Castles in the city center.

claims.text: Le SPA covers 850 square meters, with a swimming pool, a 24/7 gym, treatments, and a bar and bistro.

findings.quote: Breathe easy and get comfortable at 850m² Le Spa with swimming pool, 24/7 gym, treatments from head to toe, and a refreshing bar and bistro.

claims.text: The spa's sauna area has a 70 degree sauna, a 90 degree sauna and an infrared cabin.

findings.quote: besides the pool, you find an elegant sauna area with 70° + 90° sauna and infrared cabin.

claims.text: Le SPA treatments include classic massages, hot stone ceremonies, Ayurvedic massages and foot massages.

findings.quote: In addition to classic massages and hot stone ceremonies, you can also indulge in Ayurvedic massages or foot massages.

claims.text: Rooms have views of the green garden or the city, with modern furniture and innovative art.

findings.quote: Views of the green garden or city view, modern furniture and innovative art will take you upon a discovery journey of Le Méridien Stuttgart.

claims.text: Bathroom amenities are by MALIN + GOETZ.

findings.quote: Enjoy a Le Méridien exclusive with our bathroom amenities by MALIN + GOETZ.

claims.text: The restaurant serves a Sunday brunch with live cooking stations and an à la carte dinner menu of regional and international specialties.

findings.quote: an exclusive Sunday brunch (12:00–15:00) with live cooking stations and drinks, and an à la carte dinner menu featuring regional and international specialties.

claims.text: Bar Lillet is named after the house aperitif Lillet, a French aperitif that inspired Bond author Ian Fleming.

findings.quote: Named after the house aperitif - Lillet, a French aperitif that already inspired Bond author Ian Fleming

claims.text: The meeting foyer has a spiral staircase.

findings.quote: Highlight: the meeting foyer with a noble spiral staircase is the perfect gathering place.

claims.text: The Mercedes-Benz Museum is 10 minutes by car from the hotel, and the Porsche Museum is reachable by public transport.

findings.quote: Discover the impressive Mercedes Benz Museum which is only 10 minutes by car from Le Méridien Stuttgart.
For automobile enthusiasts, the Porsche Museum and Mercedes-Benz Museum are easily accessible by public transport.

claims.text: All rooms and suites include complimentary access to the 850 square meter spa area with pool.

findings.quote: complimentary access to our 850 m² spa area with pool

claims.text: Through the Unlock Art program, guests get free entry to the Staatsgalerie Stuttgart by showing their room key; the museum holds 800 years of art.

findings.quote: Hotel guests get free access to the art exhibitions by presenting their room key of Le Méridien Hotel Stuttgart.
The Staatsgalerie Stuttgart, Unlock Art™ partner of Le Méridien Stuttgart, hosts 800 years of art on 9000 m² of exhibition space.

claims.text: The largest suites have a separate living room, library and conference space, with an open fireplace or a conservatory.

findings.quote: Explore a luxurious stay in Stuttgart in one of the two largest suites in town. Separate living room, library + conference space: spend quality time with family and friends at the open fire-place or conservatory

claims.text: At Le SPA, guests can swim laps in the heated pool, relax in the sauna or enjoy the sun in the garden.

findings.quote: Relax in our sauna, swim your laps in our heated pool or enjoy the sun in our garden.

claims.text: The pool has a daily kids splash time, so expect families in the pool during those hours.

findings.quote: Please note our Kids splash time daily until 1.00 PM.
findings.note: kids splash time stated daily; families in pool is the plain implication

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a tranquil atmosphere.
